brand_summary: Sarvam AI has rapidly established itself as a cornerstone of India's enterprise AI ecosystem through major partnerships with Maruti Suzuki, IndiGo, and IDFC FIRST Bank, alongside launching its highly advanced Saaras V4 multilingual speech model. Looking forward, the brand is positioning itself as a sovereign AI leader, leveraging potential IndiaAI Mission support and open-source models to challenge global tech giants on Indian linguistic terrain.
